name: dialog
description: A modal dialog component that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response. Accessible focus trap, Escape dismiss, and background scroll lock.

keyboard: Tab cycles focus strictly within dialog
Returns focus to trigger upon close
accessibility.focus: Focus trap active while modal is open, restores focus upon exit
